keyEvents.text: Goal! Marseille 1, Le Mans 0. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by CJ Egan-Riley with a through ball.
Goal! Marseille 2, Le Mans 0. Igor Paixão (Marseille) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Amine Gouiri.
Antoine Rabillard (Le Mans) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Le Mans. Jean Vercruysse replaces Antoine Rabillard.
Substitution, Le Mans. Erwan Colas replaces Dame Gueye.
Tochukwu Nnadi (Marseille) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Marseille 2, Le Mans 1. Louis Mafouta (Le Mans) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
Harold Voyer (Le Mans) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Marseille. Nouhoum Kamissoko replaces Geoffrey Kondogbia.
Substitution, Marseille. Angel Gomes replaces Tochukwu Nnadi.
Penalty saved. Louis Mafouta (Le Mans) right footed shot saved in the centre of the goal by Jeffrey de Lange (Marseille).
Himad Abdelli (Marseille) is shown the yellow card.
Rayan Bamba (Le Mans) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Le Mans. Noa Boissé replaces Lucas Buadés.
Substitution, Le Mans. Raúl Torrente replaces Harold Voyer.
Substitution, Le Mans. William Harhouz replaces Louis Mafouta.
Goal! Marseille 2, Le Mans 2. Erwan Colas (Le Mans) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Daouda Traoré (Le Mans) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Marseille. Alexi Koum replaces Ulisses Garcia.
Substitution, Marseille. Keyliane Abdallah replaces Amine Harit.
Goal! Marseille 2, Le Mans 3. Jean Vercruysse (Le Mans) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Rayan Bamba.
